Can you believe this is in Kyoto?👀
but this Kyoto café feels straight out of a Studio Ghibli movie! I was searching for a different café when it suddenly started raining, and I ended up here by accident, best detour ever. This cozy spot is run by the sweetest old lady and has the perfect cove view of Ine! They serve real Uji matcha, and since it was summer, I had to get the matcha ice cream. If you’re planning a day trip from Kyoto, don’t skip Ine and save this café if you want a magical, peaceful escape! Send this to someone who needs a real life Studio Ghibli moment!

Introducing… your next new favorite Izakaya in Japan 🇯🇵

When you’re traveling it can be easy to only hit up the spots that are in the main areas or places you’ve seen online that are just “instagramable”. 

But let me do you a favor and put you on Torizikozu.
You may have already heard of this somewhere but I have been going here since I was 6 or 7 years old and this place really doesn’t disappoint. 

The food isn’t going to be the most luxurious thing you’ve had or seen, but they are consistent with their quality, they’ve got so much variety (yes even for your picky friends), and most importantly it’s AFFORDABLE 🙌🏻🔥😅

Not sponsored but @torikizoku.official I’ve been your biggest fan for years🫶 (plz notice me lol)

transcription: Would you believe me if I said that all of this costs $370, no matter what you get? What I mean is regardless of what you order from the menu, whether it's a drink or this all-you-can-eat cabbage, which is bomb, each dish will only cost you $370. I have been coming to this isakaia since I was 7 years old, and although I've got to be honest and say the quality has dropped a little, I have yet to come across a place that gives you more bang for your buck and with this quality. Some dishes I personally recommend is this juicy, chicken thigh jumbo stick covered in sweet sauce. You also got to try this grilled mochi ball stick that's covered in cheese and seaweed flakes. Most of these dishes haven't really changed since I first ate here but the one thing that did downgrade is this beef stick that used to be juicy but now is kind of dry. What's crazy is this place is so popular that they've got over 650 stores all over Japan. So whether it's for date night or just drinks with your friends, if you're looking for something affordable, fun, and consistent, I think this might be your place.
